summary: Extends OSPF versions 2 and 3 to flood traffic engineering information about links between Autonomous Systems, supporting MPLS and GMPLS TE path computation across multiple ASes. It does not define flooding of information from one AS into another. This is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: Routers tell their neighbors about the roads they can use. This lets them also share facts about the bridges that lead out to other networks, so trip planners can use them.
